aboutTitle: Turn OD relationships into reliable patient volume
about: Join the Ophthalmology Business Academy for a referral growth panel exploring how ophthalmology practices can build stronger, more productive partnerships with referring optometrists — and turn those relationships into a consistent source of patient volume.

This discussion will examine what actually creates trust between ODs and ophthalmologists, where referral handoffs commonly break down, and what referring providers expect from their ophthalmology partners beyond strong clinical outcomes. Panelists will also explore practical strategies such as clearer communication, faster reporting, referral liaisons, education, co-management, and digital referral systems to help practices strengthen relationships, reduce patient leakage, and build a more reliable referral network.
topics: The fear of patient poaching exists on both sides — the behaviours, agreements, and communication practices that create genuine trust between ophthalmologists and referring optometrists.
Who should own each stage of the referral handoff, and what practices should track to identify delays, patient leakage, and breakdowns in communication.
Beyond strong clinical outcomes — what a referring optometrist needs from an ophthalmology partner: faster access, clearer updates, reliable patient return, or direct physician communication.
CE dinners, referral liaisons, digital referral systems, and faster reporting — which activities genuinely strengthen relationships and influence referral behaviour.
audience: You own, lead, or manage an ophthalmology practice
Referral volume is inconsistent and hard to predict
Patients leak out of the OD-to-MD handoff and never return
You want a co-management relationship ODs genuinely trust
You're investing in liaisons, CE events, or referral tech and want them to pay off

panelists.name: Chris Bonsall
panelists.bio: Chris Bonsall helps lead Navigate Patient Solutions, where he works with ophthalmology practices to improve the patient experience before cataract evaluations. His team focuses on preparing and educating patients earlier in their care journey. By improving communication and disrupting traditional education methods, they help reduce fear and anxiety surrounding cataract surgery. That same earlier-touch philosophy shapes how he approaches the OD-to-MD referral handoff.

panelists.name: Sean Hanlon
panelists.bio: Sean is the Founder and Chief Commercial Officer of CoFi, a multi-party payments platform used by more than 17,000 optometrists and ophthalmologists and processing hundreds of millions of dollars in ophthalmic surgery payments annually. Previously, he co-founded Turf, helping ophthalmology practices understand their optometric referral markets and strengthen compliant referral and co-management relationships — personally meeting with more than 1,000 optometrists along the way. Sean is a recognized expert on ophthalmic co-management and regularly speaks at major industry meetings including AECOS, ASCRS, ASOA, and AAO.

panelists.name: Amanda Cardwell Carones
panelists.bio: Amanda brings 25 years of MedTech experience, including 23 years in patient-pay ophthalmology, working with clinicians, industry leaders, and global eye-health organizations. She specializes in helping practices and manufacturers translate complex clinical information into patient-friendly communication that builds trust and supports premium technology adoption. Her work focuses on patient communication, workflow optimization, education, and practice growth. She is also the founder of Ophthalpreneurs®, a global community focused on advancing leadership, communication, and innovation in ophthalmology.

panelists.name: Christine Lapointe
panelists.bio: Christine Lapointe is an accomplished consultant and executive with 34 years of experience spanning business development, sales, marketing, staff training, team building, and strategic partnerships. They are recognized for consistently exceeding organizational goals while building strong, productive professional relationships. A committed mentor, they focus on identifying individual strengths and creating opportunities that lead to successful partnerships and outcomes. They are also a global motivational speaker and published author.
